items.title: Future Designs carbon careful™ initiative preserves existing luminaires across Crawley schools
items.summary: Future Designs' carbon careful initiative replaced fluorescent classroom luminaires with LED across three Crawley secondary schools, retaining existing fixture housings to cut embodied carbon in the retrofit.

items.title: Modeling When Light Matters Most for Circadian Health
items.summary: New modeling research indicates circadian and sleep effects depend on cumulative 24-hour light exposure rather than simple morning/evening rules, showing that adequate daytime brightness can buffer against disruptive evening light.

items.title: Smart Home Trends For Multifamily Properties
items.summary: A Parks Associates whitepaper argues multifamily properties are shifting from standalone smart-home features to unified building-intelligence platforms, positioning lighting controls as one component within integrated connectivity, access and energy management systems.

items.title: Lucent Lighting elevates rooftop escape AZOTEA Leeds with layered architectural lighting
items.summary: A layered lighting scheme by Mistry Lighting, using luminaires supplied by Lucent Lighting, was installed at AZOTEA, a rooftop restaurant and bar in Leeds.

items.title: FCC Approves Controversial Satellite Mirror Project
items.summary: The FCC approved a test launch for Reflect Orbital's mirror satellite, a space-based light-delivery concept raising regulatory concerns over light pollution and public safety relevant to outdoor lighting practice.

items.title: Will Mineral Paints Gain Traction In The Lighting Industry?
items.summary: Mineral-based coatings, valued for breathability and durability in heritage and eco-building work, are being floated as an alternative finish for luminaire housings versus conventional paint or powder coat, though adoption in fixture manufacturing remains speculative.

items.title: Collingwood lights up Northampton Saints hospitality and net zero drive
items.summary: Collingwood Lighting supplied and designed an LED fitting refurbishment for Northampton Saints' Barwell stand as phase one of a project aimed at improving hospitality lighting and reducing the club's carbon footprint.

items.title: House Passes Bill To Create Permanent Daylight Savings Time
items.summary: The US House passed a bill to make daylight saving time permanent, pending Senate and presidential approval; the lighting industry implication concerns how such scheduling shifts affect lighting demand and design, not the clock change itself.

items.title: DLC Finalizes Networked Lighting Controls (NLC) V5.2
items.summary: The DesignLights Consortium finalized NLC V5.2, taking effect August 2026, tightening interoperability and reporting requirements and extending networked lighting controls' role into integrated building systems such as HVAC.
